newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico tightens liquidity objective.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico tightens liquidity objective.

text.p: Banco de Mexico has changed its daily liquidity objective to minus 20 million pesos from a previous zero objective, dealers said.
The objective has been zero since August 16.
Dealers said the central bank was seeking to reduce liquidity in the system in order to create an increase in interest rates and help support the weakening peso.
"In the short run the exchange rate has been moving too much and it was necessary to take some measures to control the fall of the peso," said one dealer.
